manifest.name: Shopping list
manifest.description: Reads out and ticks off your Home Assistant shopping list with the buttons of your headphones while you are in a supermarket zone. Add it once per person, with their own player.

player_id.label: Player
player_id.description: The player your headphones are connected to, usually your phone in the Music Assistant app.

person_entity.label: Person
person_entity.description: The Home Assistant person whose location counts, such as person.alex.

zone_entities.label: Supermarket zones
zone_entities.description: The Home Assistant zones in which shopping mode is on, such as your supermarkets.

switch_entity.label: Switch for shopping mode (optional)
switch_entity.description: A Home Assistant switch, such as input_boolean.shopping_mode. While it is on, shopping mode is on wherever you are: switch it from a widget, by voice or from an automation. The buttons below then switch it too.

start_shopping.label: Start shopping mode now
start_shopping.description: Starts shopping mode outside of the zones. It stays on until you end it; without a switch it ends when the plugin restarts, also after saving the settings.

stop_shopping.label: End shopping mode
stop_shopping.description: Ends a shopping mode that was started by hand. In a zone it stays on until you leave.

todo_entity.label: Shopping list
todo_entity.description: The Home Assistant to-do list to read, such as todo.shopping_list.

zone_todo.label: Shopping list in {0}
zone_todo.description: The to-do list read in this zone. Leave it empty for the shopping list above.

remove_items.label: Delete entries instead of ticking them off
remove_items.description: Two presses delete the entry from the list instead of marking it as completed.

tts_engine.label: Text-to-speech engine
tts_engine.description: The voice that reads the entries. Home Assistant offers each of its text-to-speech entities here, such as Google Translate or Piper.

chime.label: Chime before announcements
chime.description: Play a short chime before each entry is read.

silent_after_app_pause.label: Player stays silent after a pause on the headphones
silent_after_app_pause.description: Turn on for apps such as MassDroid, which keep an announcement silent after their own pause: reading then plays the music again for a moment first, which takes a few seconds longer.

config_actions.not_started: The shopping list is empty: shopping mode not started.
